# llms.txt — Sparkers Games System Summary for AI Assistants

# Title
Sparkers Games Platform

# Summary
Sparkers Games is a free digital card game engine, couples relationship hub, and party game library featuring 89+ games, interactive quizzes, and custom party generators. Available at sparkersgames.com — no download or sign-up required.

# Core Topics
- Party Games (/en/play) — Truth or Dare, Never Have I Ever, Would You Rather, Charades, Mafia
- Couples & Relationship Games (/en/couples) — Deep Intimacy decks, romantic conversation starters
- Quizzes & Personality Indicators (/en/quizzes) — Love Language, Attachment Style
- Generators (/en/generators) — Wheel Spinner, Couple Name Generator
- Rules & Encyclopedia (/en/encyclopedia)
- Article & Relationship Guides (/en/blog)
- Physical Card Decks (/en/cards)

- Brand: Sparkers Games
- Primary Website: https://sparkersgames.com
